title: Krawtchouk Polynomial and Generating Coefficient
statement: Let $n,z,j$ be nonnegative integers with $z\le n$, and let $K_{n,j}$ be the Krawtchouk polynomial. Then $K_{n,j}(z)$ equals the coefficient of $X^j$ in $(1-X)^z(1+X)^{n-z}$.
